xhs.title: 一个函数，狗和猫都能用？
xhs.body:
第 15 课：trait，定义共同行为
trait 是一份行为清单：trait Speak { fn speak(&self) -> String; }
impl Speak for Dog：给类型实现它
参数写 &impl Speak，一个函数就能接收所有实现了 Speak 的类型
方法可以带默认实现；没有默认实现的，必须自己写
考考你：trait 里有 fn speak(&self) -> String; 写 impl Speak for Dog {} 能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: One Rust function that works for both Dog and Cat? That's what traits are for. Quick quiz: the trait has fn speak(&self) -> String; and you write impl Speak for Dog {}. Does it compile? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: Rust traits: one function, many types
linkedin.body:
A trait is a list of behaviors: trait Speak { fn speak(&self) -> String; }
impl Speak for Dog gives a type that behavior.
A parameter of type &impl Speak accepts any type that implements Speak, checked at compile time.
Trait methods can have default bodies; methods without one must be implemented.
Quick quiz: the trait has fn speak(&self) -> String; and you write impl Speak for Dog {}. Does it compile? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: trait Speak { fn speak(&self) -> String; } struct Dog; impl Speak for Dog {} 能编译吗？
quiz.q_en: trait Speak { fn speak(&self) -> String; } struct Dog; impl Speak for Dog {}  Does it compile?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：不能。speak 没有默认实现，impl Speak for Dog 必须把它写出来，否则报错 E0046：not all trait items implemented, missing: `speak`。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: no. speak has no default body, so impl Speak for Dog must define it. Otherwise you get error E0046: not all trait items implemented, missing: `speak`.
